name: pull-object
title: Pull an object closer
description: Drag an object toward the robot with the pads pressed on its top until it is within reach (e.g. from the back of a deep counter); if the pads slide over a round or slippery top, the fingers hook the far side and push it toward the robot.
use_when: An object is too far back on a deep support to grasp and must come closer.

not_to_be_confused_with.push: push moves the object away from the robot or sideways.

preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

postconditions.meaning: Object's horizontal distance to the base decreased by at least half the requested distance.
From the current base pose the right TCP has a collision-free IK solution 10 cm above the target (handle pre-grasp for doors, 8 cm in front of a button).

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
